It has a variety of manicure/pedicure attachments, but I use mainly the conical shaped file, which is superior to my old one. I am seeing a foot doctor about a real bad, thick nail fungus on my right big toe, a problem I've had for years. After nearly clipping the nail to its root on my toe, she told me to diligently file the nail as it continues to grow back before I apply anti-fungal treatment to it each day. So instead of using an emery board, I now use this rechargeable pedicure machine. reviews.t: why did i wait so long?
reviews.x: I finally got myself this mani/pedi station. I should have gotten it long ago! I love that I can use it with or without the cord. Plus, I am now wearing artificial nails. Sometimes, I feel like the underneath sides need smoothed out between fill-ins. This tool can do it! I also had a hip replacement this year. I can't keep my foot up too long, so this allows me to complete the filing much faster, and remove dead skin. I would recommend this to any lady, young or old.

This I use as a pedicure--it has taken off "things" that have been on my toes for years, and improved the appearance of my feet immeasurably!  I can also file down thick toenails, and do all sorts of things--great set of tools!

I did a lot of research before settling on this set and I am glad I did.  The quality is definitely there!  It has enough power and a large enough assortment of tips to tackle thickened toenails or delicate manicures.  I'm seriously thinking about trying it on my Dog's toenails.  Lol No joke, I think it could handle it.  Being battery operated, it is fairly quiet which is always a good thing.  I think that for the money it was an excellent purchase and expect to give it a lot of use.
This has replaced my clippers. I have diabetes and am very careful not to injure my feet. My toenails respond well to filing so I don't have to worry about accidently clipping the skin around them.

I had an older one I lost while moving and ordered this one a week ago. It was a bit pricey compared to other brands. Maybe because it has a docking station for re-chargeable batteries. I needed to use mine ASAP, so I removed the re-chargeable's and put in 2 AA's. worked GREAT! I have pitted nails from psoriasis and use these type tools to smooth my nails from pits made from my skin cells regenerating to quickly. I use one several times a week. this is not what it says it is. i got this and it doesnt have the power to do anything it states. very misled by ad on amazon. really crap product. im trying to yard sale this junk for 2.00 and it wont sell!!!!! very upset over ad.

I'm really not understanding the good reviews on this product, it just doesn't make sense to me.  This thing has no power at all - it might be different if it was variable power and this was the "low" setting, but it just bogs down completely the minute it touches your nail or tough skin.  The attachments really are lame too - they each are supposed to have a different purpose, but each one performs about the same.  It is battery operated or AC plug in. reviews.x: I purchased this manicure/pedicure set to replace a 15-year-old Homedics StyleSpa Deluxe that was no longer holding its charge. Having read your reviews of the newer version of the Homedics manicure/pedicure sets, I decided that this Medicool product sounded like a better one. Well, the Medicool Manicure Pedicure Station is OK - it does a good job - BUT it has only half the tools that my old Homedics product does. Now, when I do my nails, I use BOTH products - the Medicool for the basics (like t

I bought this so that I could do my own 'callous removing' rather than getting charged an extra five bucks every time I had a pedicure. I don't know if the salon uses something more along the lines of a garage tool, but this little guy was like a barbie version...when I applied it to my heels it just skimmed the top similar to what I could do with a regular manual nail file and ran out of juice quick. I'm going to have to visit Sears with the hubby, I guess...Certainly not worth the $50 I paid f

I tried the basic filing disc attachment. A light pressure does next to nothing. Applying enough pressure to start wearing away the nail causes the device to slow down and finally come to a complete stop. It seems rather toy like. I plan on getting a nail "drill" tool with enough POWER to do something like this one: [[ASIN:B006ZAPMT8 VOGUE PROFESSIONAL brand Powerful Slim Lightweight Pro Nail Art Drill KIT Electric FILE Buffer with 7 Specialty Bits]]

reviews.t: it broke the first time I use it
reviews.x: I use to have a manicure kit similar to this it lasted 10 year until the battery did not charge anymore and have to throw it away. I bough this one to replace the old one. One of the attachment broke the first time I use it in my finger. I returned and got a refund. Not good quality at all, I don't recommend this product.

This is OK I guess but does seem to "stall" A LOT!!! You have to use a light hand even while plugged in. Disappointing as I wanted to use it for dry, rough skin on heels,ect. Bought a similar product yrs ago for about the same price on HSN and it worked much better.

Sounded good, looked good, was impressed with the online description,  However, when I used it on my toenails, all it did was jump and skip. I was totally frustrated and immediately packed it back up and returned it.
This product didn't have enough power to smooth away a callous. If too much pressure is applied it stopped. It took forever to shape a nail. I returned it.
The main Unit is OK, even though it does not have much power. The tools (attachments) comes with it does not do any thing. I will not buy this unit again.
Feels like cheap plastic but it works. I have no problem with mine. Not good for heavy duty pedis but everyday grooming needs it fine.
This kit is a total waste of time. You would way outperform it with a hand file. Threw it in the garbage !

This works exactly as stated. Mine came perfectly boxed with all parts and an instruction booklet. So far the batteries keep their charge for a long time--I have used it briefly on occasion and now, today, continuously for about a half an hour and they still haven't hesitated. The cord included is the spiral type ("telephone"-style) so it can be stretched as needed, should I want to use the unit for a longer time. The filing bits appear sturdy and made very short work of my fingernails.
As everyone, i was trying to save money! And ooh i was right  in this one. My nails look like i had a professional session when i did it at home.you will not regret buying this
the tips would not stay in and very shoddily made. Sent back and go back to using my 15 year old model

claims.text: Many reviewers find the tool effective for filing thick toenails and improving foot appearance, with several calling it a great buy.
A common complaint is that the device lacks power and stalls or bogs down under light pressure, making it feel toy-like.
Reviewers appreciate the cordless convenience and docking/charging base, with some noting it can also run on AA batteries.
Some users report quality issues, including attachments breaking on first use and the product being overpriced.
Several reviewers compare it unfavorably to older or previous models they owned, saying those worked better.
